findings.message: action dim 3: 7.0% of commands during motion are pinned at exactly its min (0.45) - clipped commands the policy will imitate
action dim 4: 7.0% of commands during motion are pinned at exactly its max (-0.4) - clipped commands the policy will imitate
action dim 12: 55% of commands sit exactly at its max - a gripper or on/off command rather than clipping?
action dim 20: 16.3% of commands during motion are pinned at exactly its max (1.0472) - clipped commands the policy will imitate
observation.state dim 65: std 7.24e-09 - near-zero variance amplifies noise after normalization
observation.state dim 143: std 1.19e-07 - near-zero variance amplifies noise after normalization
observation.state dim 144: std 4.00e-07 - near-zero variance amplifies noise after normalization
action dim 6: constant (std=0) - carries no signal; if it ever varies at deployment, mean/std normalization (std + 1e-8) blows it up. Usually padding; consider dropping it
